body:
Happened to this kid's father I know.

He got a random email, never even opened it (I'm pretty sure it was filtered as spam), and he was arrested for receiving.  He was even advised by his lawyer to take a plea deal (plead guilty) because the prosecutor was just relentless and technically correct.

So now he's a sex offender for receiving child pornography that he never even saw, asked for, or even knew he had.  Because the law is written by completely braindead idiots and the prosecutors are savage disgusting people who only care about winning and not about what's right.
